name: Bottom-up SVO to DAG Reduction
aliases: SVO to Directed Acyclic Graph (DAG) Reduction
Sparse Voxel Octree (SVO) to Directed Acyclic Graph (DAG) Reduction

summary: Bottom-up SVO to DAG Reduction compresses Sparse Voxel Octrees by iteratively merging identical subtrees from leaves to root, ensuring minimal graph size unlike top-down methods.
